description: This file defines and configures locale-specific settings for a date manipulation library, including date formats, day and month names in the Tswana (South Africa) language, regex patterns for parsing dates, and various date-related utility functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a Date object to midnight (00:00:00).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of a Date object to the current local time.
